mapper.select: select id, member_id as memberId, name, phone, address, longitude, latitude, category, tags, source, contact_open as contactOpen, coop_open as coopOpen, (6371000 * acos(least(1, cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(cast(latitude as decimal(12,7)))) * cos(radians(cast(longitude as decimal(12,7))) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(cast(latitude as decimal(12,7)))) ))) as distance from merchant_lead where del_flag = 0 and status = 1 and latitude is not null and latitude != '' and longitude is not null and longitude != '' having distance <= #{radius} order by distance asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_lead (member_id, name, phone, address, longitude, latitude, category, tags, source, contact_open, coop_open, status, del_flag, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{source}, #{contactOpen}, #{coopOpen}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, member_id as memberId, name, phone, address, longitude, latitude, category, tags, source, contact_open as contactOpen, coop_open as coopOpen, status, del_flag as delFlag, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from merchant_lead where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: update merchant_lead set del_flag = 2 where id in #{id}
